acceptance: All 24 slots valid and 12 matched pairs. Require >=10/12 favorable, >=3% median paired reduction, >=4,000,000 median fewer process instructions per corpus pass (paired command difference divided by 4), one-sided exact balanced randomized-order p<=0.01 on mean paired log change, with (3rd,10th) of the 12 paired percentages, 96.14% distribution-free median interval. Run only this one conjunction. Null/adverse closes trial. A passing result can only advance to a separately registered matched full-Cargo study on a different independent workload.
metric: Complete-process user-space retired-equivalent app instruction total from a fresh, direct, pinned DynamoRIO process; one B/T/F/P roster, no children. No wall endpoint. Pair individual observations at the scheduled order. Report raw signed results even on a null or adverse run.
native_admission: On one sponsor-approved reserved x86-64 linux host, freeze host, CPU availability, assigned single core, effective library/collector hashes, exact absolute ELF and corpus paths, process environment, and complete runnable worker hashes before any exposure. Validate all 1238 SHA256, all 5200 synthetic/96 mutating-file/packet/fixed-read checks and C/Python oracle. Then run the exact uncounted before/after replay with four sweeps each, regular immutable files, 4952 successful input opens (each source four times) and complete identical per-file read request lengths, return values and EOF counts on the same descriptors. Require exact common expected stdout and no other execution in either arm; retain native raw. Read/corpus bytes and content hashes fixed. Host grant and native receipt required; no release profiles or full Cargo runs implied.
primary: 12 pairs, 6 BA/6 AB in the frozen order; fresh processes, same single core/host/logical paths/common executable/inputs/environment, same four corpus passes. After all pairs, one native before+after to recheck ordinary outputs and input hashes. No cherry-picking, retries or alternate candidate. Halt and retain failure if an individual slot lacks complete instrumentation, exits nonzero, prints other bytes, starts a child, or any corpus/host/tool precondition changes. No scored row may be replaced.
scope: Isolated exact checksum methods and captured Ruff source files. This is not a Cargo performance comparison.
stage: Prospective separate host grant and host/native admission still required. Zero counted observations at freeze.
